author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time we take a look at what appears to be a little win in the age verification fight as lawmakers are finding that their pointless laws are virtually unenforceable forcing them and big tech companies to fight until slowly realizing this should belong up to the parents rather than the government. Thanks for watching!
Like, Comment and Subscribe for more videos!
title: We're Starting To Win The Age Verification Fight...
